title: boechera crandallii subsp. kelseyana
intro: Boechera crandallii subsp. kelseyana, commonly known as Kelsey's rockcress, is a subspecies of the Boechera crandallii plant, belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including its potential to have anti-inflammatory properties, which may provide relief from pain and inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents, including isothiocyanates and glucosinolates, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Kelsey's rockcress, and its bioactive constituents are still being studied for their potential applications in medicine.
